scientific_integrity: The orbit-centralizer formula, root Jordan types, and rank interval are algebraically proved; the verification program tests independent finite enumerations. Same-model review only; no independent audit or external certification.
scientific_limitations: Counts labeled finite-field matrix roots only for a nonzero rank-one square-zero target. Does not address the zero target, other nilpotent target types, nonreduced schemes or simultaneous conjugation orbits. Exhaustive computations cover only listed finite cases; broader formulas have an algebraic proof. Historical priority is provisional, since a general orbit-fiber enumeration might subsume this explicit rank refinement.
title: Rank-resolved finite-field power roots of the minimal nonzero nilpotent orbit
